item.title: Australian Fisherman Reels in 440-Pound Bull Shark Amid Spree of Attacks
item.description: An Australian fisherman was filmed reeling in a large bull shark near a popular Sydney beach this week amid a wave of attacks in the region.

item.title: 15 Hikers Rescued After Getting Lost in Utah Slot Canyon
item.description: The hikers were found lost and suffering from extreme cold in a slot canyon in Washington County, Utah, but rescuers managed to take them to safety.

item.title: Nazaré Surf Could Get to ‘100 Feet’ as Europe Braces for Massive Storm Ingrid
item.description: Western Europe is preparing to be battered by storm Ingrid. Nic von Rupp says the system could create the mythical 100-foot wave at Nazaré.

item.title: Pipeline Pro Challenger Field Will Feature 8 Championship Tour Surfers
item.description: The World Surf League announced that Challenger Series surfers will have to compete against a handful of Championship Tour heavies at Pipeline.

item.title: Koa Rothman Breaks Down What Happened to the Da Hui Backdoor Shootout
item.description: The Da Hui Backdoor Shootout is one of the most exciting events in surfing. This year, Mother Nature wasn't excited to join the party. Koa Rothman explains.

item.title: Two Hikers Killed By Falling Tree in Washington State
item.description: Two hikers were killed by a falling tree on a popular trail in the Olympic National Forest, located in Washington state.

item.title: Footage Shows Cyclone Harry Wreaking Havoc on Mediterranean Coasts
item.description: The most intense parts of Cyclone Harry have passed but local authorities on the Mediterranean coasts were still on alert Thursday as recovery began.

item.title: Ben Gravy Has Tips on How to Make Cold Water Surfing a Little Less Awful
item.description: Ben Gravy has spent the last decade or so on a mission. In his travels, he's surfed many waves, some warm, some cold. Some colder than others.

item.title: Jordy Smith Scored a Crazy South African Novelty Wave
item.description: When Jordy Smith saw what Six Pillars, a novelty wave par excellence in South Africa, was doing, he turned into a frothing grom. Then he surfed it like a pro.
